name: collab.claim
title: collab.claim
summary: Claim entities, components, documents or files for your turn, with an expiry. Advisory only; never blocks edits.
html:
Claim entities, components, documents or files for your turn, with an expiry. Advisory only; never blocks edits.

  • Scope: edit:scene
  • Service: collab
  • MCP: ara_session with "action": "claim"

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin.
subjectsyesWhat to claim: entity IDs or addresses (e_door01), name:Gate Door, a component or field of one (e_door01.Light), a document path (levels/outpost.scene), or another project file (@scripts/Gate.cs).
docDocument the entities are in; default: the one document holding them.
whyWhy, shown to everyone (tuning the gate).
ttlMsLifetime without heartbeats in ms (default 60000; presence updates and collab.heartbeat extend it).
